svg.text: Sleeping Giant: where Top 6 concentrate a ship or habit more than the Rest
Each dot is the centre of one laid smoke, team-normalized (north-spawn teams mirrored north-south). Outline = the spot (solid = signature, dashed = lead).
Signature: Harugumo, west edge, own side of cap A
Cruiser inside: 9 of 11 Top 6 smokes (Des Moines 5, Worcester 3).
2nd destroyer: position recorded 7 of 11, forward of the smoke 5 (Marceau 5).
Signature: flank smoke lines, east edge, outside cap D
Cruiser inside: 11 of 14 Top 6 smokes (Brisbane 4, Des Moines 2).
2nd destroyer: position recorded 10 of 14, forward of the smoke 9 (Yueyang 2).
Lead: Somers, east edge, outside cap D
Cruiser inside: 8 of 10 Top 6 smokes (Des Moines 2, Brisbane 2).
2nd destroyer: position recorded 6 of 10, forward of the smoke 5 (Châteaurenault 2).
Lead: Gdańsk, between caps B and D, own side
2nd destroyer: position recorded 9 of 10, forward of the smoke 4 (Delny 5).
